name: ElfA
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game character, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A small round wind-up tin toy elf, like an old clockwork robot toy shaped as an elf, kid-friendly: barrel-shaped tin body with rivets and a seam, a belt with a buckle, round bolt joints at the shoulders and hips, short stubby arms with mittens, short striped legs, curly-toed shoes. Big round head with big round eyes, eager toothy grin, pointed elf ears. Floppy elf hat with a bell on the tip. A big wind-up key sticking out of its back. No wings, no antennae. Full body, standing, A-pose, single character, no base, no props.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Glossy green painted tin body with gold rivets, brown belt with gold buckle, gold bolt joints, white mittens, red and white striped legs, green curly-toed shoes with gold bells. Shiny black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, peach skin. Red elf hat with white fur band and a gold bell. Brass wind-up key. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: Stand-in: hip 1.2, root 2 x 1.6 x 1 at the pivot, feet 2 studs below it, about 5 studs tall. Faces +Z in Meshy; yaw 180.

animations._note: Meshy library clips (3 credits each). Keys are what src/server/ElfBot.luau plays.

_history: 5 Nov: first try came out as a winged fairy with antennae (rejected before review); re-rolled with 'no wings'.
